responsive.layout: All grids drop to single-column (grid-cols-1) on screens < 640px. Side-by-side split views stack vertically. Navigation switches to compact bottom floating bar or mobile drawer with full touch targets.
responsive.typography: Mobile headlines use text-3xl to text-4xl, fluid scaling to text-6xl on desktop. Inputs and buttons maintain min-h-[48px] on mobile to prevent accidental zooming.
responsive.overflow_guard: All scrollable areas use overflow-x-hidden on containers and overflow-y-auto on scroll panels with touch-momentum scroll (-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch).
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px tap area for buttons, badges, tabs, and diagnostic triggers.

component_strategy.ui_library: Shadcn UI components customized with tactical dark theme (Card, Dialog, Tabs, Select, Badge, Button, Drawer, Input, Progress, Sonner)
component_strategy.icons: Lucide React icons with amber/cyan duotone accents
component_strategy.toast_notifications: Sonner toast notifications for AI Diagnosis, Booking Confirmation, Payout Releases, and Job Lead Alerts

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, fully functional two-sided AI handyman marketplace platform in React.
Support both Customer and Handyman roles seamlessly with role switching or dedicated navigation tabs.

Integrate interactive Claude 3.5 AI Vision analysis simulation: allow users to pick pre-set issue photos or upload custom images to see real-time AI bounding box analysis, identified fault, severity score, required tools, and estimated price quote.
Integrate interactive AI Repair Concierge Chatbot that answers repair questions, provides DIY advice vs pro necessity, and auto-generates job postings.
Implement AI Smart Matching: rank available handymen by calculated match fit score, distance, hourly rate, badges, and user reviews.
Implement Stripe Checkout Flow simulation for booking handymen with escrow held funds, job status progression, and instant receipt modal.
Handyman Dashboard must allow accepting/declining job leads, adjusting availability, modifying service rates, and viewing payout metrics.
Ensure every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, status badges) includes exact data-testid attributes for E2E testing.
Strictly follow mobile-first responsive design principles: layout stacks cleanly on mobile with smooth bottom drawers or tab bar.
Use Sonner for rich toast alerts on AI actions, job lead acceptance, and payments.

do_not_do: DO NOT use generic purple/white SaaS gradients or plain light backgrounds without character.
DO NOT use Inter or standard fonts for main headings; stick to Outfit for headlines and Plus Jakarta Sans for body.
DO NOT center-align the entire main container; keep asymmetric, editorial layout balance.
DO NOT use AI assistant emojis (🤖🧠💭💡) as functional icons; use crisp Lucide React icons.
DO NOT leave interactive elements without explicit data-testid attributes.
must_do: MUST enforce dark tactical slate aesthetic with warm brass (#F59E0B) highlights.
MUST make AI photo diagnosis visual and detailed (bounding box over image, severity meter, itemized parts estimate).
MUST include both Customer View and Handyman View with seamless header role-switcher.
MUST ensure mobile tap targets are at least 44px x 44px.
MUST include Stripe checkout modal with escrow payment hold simulation.
